task_language: put the white mug on the plate

subtasks.name: place(white_mug, plate, on)
subtasks.outcome: failed: mug lowered onto the plate by ~180-200 but never released; held, tilted, until timeout at 409

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct white mug and brings it down onto the plate by ~200, then keeps gripping it for 200+ steps while slowly rotating/tilting the wrist, never opening the gripper.

failures.mode_definition: The held object is brought onto or just above its destination but the gripper never opens; the policy keeps making small wrist adjustments until timeout.
failures.rl_success_check: mug upright on the plate, gripper open and clear of the mug
failures.observation: 160: mug carried above the plate; 180-200 mug base at the plate; 240-409 the gripper still holds the mug, the wrist keeps rotating and the mug tilts with its base on the plate's back half; no release in any later frame.

notes: Could also be read as pi0 never being satisfied with the mug pose (tilted mug) so it keeps adjusting; cannot tell from video whether the mug base actually contacts the plate. Same scene's other episodes show 150-200 step holds before release, so this looks like an extreme of that habit.
